description:
Turn result encryption on or off

Turns result encryption on or off for the organization's existing key pair without changing the key. Use it when the developer asks to turn encryption on or off. When on, the app's callback needs `orgEthPrivateKey` to decrypt results. Returns 404 when the organization has no key pair; create one with `issue_org_keypair`.

canEncryptResult.description: Set to true to encrypt results to the organization's public key. Set to false to deliver results as plaintext.

name: update_org_keypair
